summary.en: A small savings account scheme for a girl child, with account and deposit conditions set by current government rules.
summary.te: ప్రభుత్వ నియమాల ప్రకారం బాలిక కోసం చిన్న పొదుపు ఖాతా పథకం.
summary.hi: सरकारी नियमों के अनुसार बालिका के लिए छोटी बचत खाता योजना।

benefits: Savings account benefits and interest as per current official rules.
required_documents: Birth and guardian documents requested by the post office or participating bank
how_to_apply: Ask a post office or participating bank for current account opening rules.
helpline: Contact India Post or the participating bank.
